articles.title: A Paint-On Liquid Can Stop Cavities
articles.summary: A paint-on liquid called SDF can stop cavities in young children without drilling, a big trial has confirmed.

articles.title: Green Sea Turtles Are Making a Comeback
articles.summary: Green sea turtles are bouncing back at Aldabra and around the world, but some groups still need help.

articles.title: Circular Cities: Fix It, Don't Trash It
articles.summary: Circular cities keep materials in use through repair, reuse, and recycling instead of throwing things away.
